description: This file implements Windows-specific inter-process communication (IPC) using named pipes, including server and client connection management, security attributes, and threading.

classes.name: ipc_server_reply_data
classes.description: Holds data for replying to IPC client, including file descriptor and server thread data.

classes.name: ipc_server_thread_data
classes.description: Represents a server thread handling IPC connections, including thread ID, pipe handle, and linked list pointer.

classes.name: ipc_server_data
classes.description: Main structure for IPC server, managing threads, security, and synchronization.

classes.name: my_sa_data
classes.description: Holds security attributes and related security descriptor data for named pipe creation.

methods.name: initialize_pipe_name
methods.description: Initializes the pipe name with real path and proper formatting.

methods.name: get_active_state
methods.description: Checks the current active state of a named pipe.

methods.name: ipc_get_active_state
methods.description: Public API to get the active state of a pipe given its path.

methods.name: connect_to_server
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a server pipe with retries and timeout handling.

methods.name: ipc_client_try_connect
methods.description: Attempts to establish an IPC client connection to a named pipe.

methods.name: ipc_client_close_connection
methods.description: Closes and frees an IPC client connection.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command_to_connection
methods.description: Sends a command over an IPC connection and reads the response.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command
methods.description: Establishes connection, sends command, and closes connection.

methods.name: dup_fd_from_pipe
methods.description: Duplicates a pipe handle into a file descriptor.

methods.name: create_new_pipe
methods.description: Creates a new named pipe with security attributes.

methods.name: ipc_server_init_async
methods.description: Initializes an asynchronous IPC server with threads and named pipes.

methods.name: ipc_server_start_async
methods.description: Starts the IPC server, allowing it to accept connections.

methods.name: ipc_server_stop_async
methods.description: Signals the server to stop accepting new connections.

methods.name: ipc_server_await
methods.description: Waits for all server threads to finish and cleans up.

methods.name: ipc_server_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the IPC server.
